✨ jarm | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Identifying and grouping TLS servers on the internet based on their unique TLS configurations, with applications in security, infrastructure analysis, and threat detection.
✨ Key Features: • Active TLS server fingerprinting • Generates unique JARM fingerprints • Verifies TLS configuration consistency • Groups servers by TLS configuration
📖 Summary: JARM is a Python-based tool for active Transport Layer Security (TLS) server fingerprinting. It generates unique fingerprints for TLS servers by analyzing their responses to a series of Client Hello packets, enabling verification of TLS configurations, grouping of servers by configuration, identification of default infrastructure, and detection of malicious command and control servers.
